value.main_text_excerpt:
The beauty of high quality smolt
BioFish is a Norwegian independent producer of high-quality smolt and post-smolt. The company has a post-smolt production facility based on recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) technology, located on the west coast of Norway.
The site is ideal for producing robust and healthy smolt. Our approach to ensuring robust and healthy smolt is based on three main elements:
BioFish uses both fresh water and sea water in the production of smolt to better prepare the smolt for seawater environment.
BioFish is a strategically located RAS facility in Ljones, Western Norway
Our location in an area (PO 3) in Norway with high farming density imply shorter transportation which is beneficial for fish health and logistics. The combination of high farming density and relatively warm water increases the importance of production of robust smolt. We are focused on maintaining strong biological performance and scaling production in 2024 and 2025.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
This is BioFish
BioFish is a Norwegian independent producer of high-quality smolt and post-smolt.
The company has a RAS production facility in Ljones, close to the Hardangerfjord on the west coast of Norway. Numerous Norwegian fish farming sites are located within one day of transport. BioFish was established in 2016 and has its own uniquely built facility where the fish health and water environment have been the focus through all the decisions during the building of the production facility. BioFish holds an aquaculture license for 5 million smolt and a discharge license for 2,200 tons.
Our story
A new 2,000m2 production facility was finalised, and the installation process of four new modern growth tanks reached its final stages.
BioFish acquired an on-land fish farming facility in Ljones from Green Salmar’s bankruptcy estate.
After the acquisition, BioFish transformed the facility into a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS).
Management
Lena Hovda Aas
Managing Director
Lena Hovda Aas (born 1998) was appointed Operations manager in January 2024.
Hovda Aas joined BioFish in May 2023 as production biologist. She also has experience from part-time work during studies.
She holds a bachelor of business and environmental science in aquaculture from James Cook University, Singapore, and a master’s degree in fishery and aquaculture science from the Arctic University of Norway.
Hovda Aas owns 0 shares in BioFish.

Company news
BioFish has entered into an agreement with a recognised industry player for the delivery of approximately 170 000 -180 000 post-smolt of 250-300 grams. The contract has been secured under market terms, with delivery scheduled for the second half of August 2024.
BioFish has entered into an agreement with a recognised
industry player for the delivery of approximately 170 000 -180 000 post-smolt of 500 grams. The contract has been secured under market terms, with delivery
scheduled for August 2024.
Biofish Holding AS is pleased to announce that BioFish has signed a contract for delivery of 400 000 postsmolt of 600 gram in spring 2025 and 400 000 postmolt of 600 gram in spring 2026.
Johnny Duedahl has been appointed Chief Financial Officer (“CFO”) of Biofish Holding AS (“BioFish”), effective from today, 1 March 2024. Duedahl has served as interim CFO of BioFish since October 2023.
